newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil publishes bid specs for Credireal's selloff.
newsitem.headline: Brazil publishes bid specs for Credireal's selloff.

text.p: Minas Gerais state government published on Friday the bid specifications for the privatization of its state bank Credireal scheduled for April 30.

The state will sell 52.385 million common shares and 20.359 million preferred shares, representing 99.537 percent of Credireal's voting capital and 99.243 percent of the bank's total capital, the tender document said.
Credireal's minimum price will be set on March 31, it added.
The tender document said foreign investors will be allowed to take part in the auction but it vetoes the participation of local pension funds.
Employees and retirees will have the right to acquire up to 10 percent of the voting shares or 5.262 million stocks at a 50 percent discount, the tender document said.
Interested investors will have to pre-qualify for the auction between February 17 and 28, it added.
With the selloff of Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj expected for February, Credireal would be the second of Brazilian state banks to be privatized.
Credireal has 86 branches in 13 Brazilian states.
